attributes.action: Make wearing a helmet a legal requirement when riding a bike
attributes.additional_details:
Every year, thousands of cyclists suffer preventable, life-altering head injuries and fatal trauma on our roads. While seatbelts are mandatory in cars, basic head protection on bicycles remains optional—leaving riders needlessly vulnerable. 

Making helmets a legal requirement could save lives, reduce severe brain injuries, and ensure safety is standard for every cyclist. Sign this petition to demand legislation that protects all riders on our roads.
attributes.background:
In this day and age, the roads are extremely busy and becoming increasingly dangerous for cyclists especially if they aren’t wearing a helmet.

Some children find it embarrassing to wear a helmet, which I believe is why a lot of people don’t wear one. 

Helmets can save someone’s life.
